title: Self-Representation Alignment in Diffusion Models for Video Background Music Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.15575v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion models have been widely used for various generative tasks. However, recent studies have demonstrated that the internal representations learned in the diffusion models' denoising process are insufficiently meaningful, which can hinder the generation performance. To address this, we propose a novel diffusion U-Net architecture enhanced by explicitly aligning the weaker representation from the earlier layer conditioned on higher noise with the better representation from the later layer conditioned on lower noise during training, which we use for the challenging multimodal task of video background music generation. Our diffusion U-Net Self-Representation Alignment (U-SRA) employs an alignment loss to effectively guide our diffusion model to learn good internal representations, thereby enabling it to produce higher-quality symbolic music conditioned on video features. translated_title: 扩散模型中的自表示对齐用于视频背景音乐生成
translated_abstract: 扩散模型已被广泛应用于各类生成任务。然而，近期研究表明，扩散模型去噪过程中学习到的内部表示缺乏足够的语义意义，这可能阻碍其生成性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的扩散U-Net架构，通过在训练期间显式地将较高噪声条件下较早层的较弱表示与较低噪声条件下较后层的较好表示进行对齐来增强模型，并将其应用于视频背景音乐生成这一具有挑战性的多模态任务。我们的扩散U-Net自表示对齐（U-SRA）方法采用对齐损失，有效引导扩散模型学习良好的内部表示，从而使其能够以视频特征为条件生成更高质量的符号音乐。我们还采用交叉注意力机制使音乐与视频同步（摘要在此处不完整，内容被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出扩散U-Net自表示对齐（U-SRA）方法，通过在训练中对齐去噪过程中不同噪声层级的层间表示来增强扩散模型的内部表示学习能力，从而在视频背景音乐生成任务中生成更高质量的符号音乐。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a Diffusion U-Net Self-Representation Alignment (U-SRA) method that enhances diffusion models' internal representations by aligning earlier-layer representations with later-layer ones across noise levels during training, enabling higher-quality video-conditioned symbolic background music generation.
